form_title: FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.notes: Handwritten and FAX-TRANSMITTED (fax header '05/16/2018 12:40 01 ... PAGE 01/05'), so the scan is coarse. Amounts are written without a thousands comma ('4105.43') - transcribed verbatim. Lines 3 and 7 are slashed-zero glyphs, transcribed as '0'. TWO DIFFERENT DATES appear: the cover signature reads 'May 14, 2018' (medium confidence - the day digits are fax-degraded) while the summary page's own 'Date of Report' box reads '5/1/18'; report_date holds the cover signature date. The office field 'Ut. County Commission Seat A' agrees with office_index (County Commission Seat A). Only the '30 Days after withdraw or elimination' box carries a check; the 'Seven days preceding the General Election' box has a fax speck, not a mark.
